title: Spotify
summary: A monitoring Profile based on Spotify's current mastering guidance.
descriptionMarkdown: Spotify describes playback normalisation and mastering guidance rather than a delivery acceptance specification. This Profile warns when a master is louder than the normal playback target and checks the general True Peak recommendation. Spotify also advises a stricter True Peak ceiling when a master is louder than target; the current PLVS rule model cannot express that conditional relationship, so review the source guidance when the Integrated warning is active. Playback behaviour can vary by normalisation setting and device.

references.title: Loudness Normalization on Spotify
references.relevanceMarkdown: Describes Spotify playback normalisation, the mastering target, general True Peak guidance and the conditional advice for masters above target.

releases.notesMarkdown: Initial curated release based on Spotify's current public guidance.
